description: This Java class defines an event handling strategy for the 'AclEntryDeleted' event within the Eclipse Ditto services, specifically for processing ACL entry deletion events related to 'things'. It extends an abstract event strategy and overrides a method to modify a 'ThingBuilder' instance based on the event.

classes.name: AclEntryDeletedStrategy
classes.description: A final class that implements a specific event handling strategy for 'AclEntryDeleted' events, modifying 'ThingBuilder' instances accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides a method to handle 'AclEntryDeleted' events by removing permissions associated with the event's authorization subject from the provided 'ThingBuilder'.
